title: North Carolina farmer Noah Ranells has permanently protected 63 acres of his farm
summary_full: Noah Ranells has taken a significant step by permanently conserving 63 acres of Fickle Creek Farm in Alamance County, North Carolina. This proactive move comes after a concerning decline in local farmland over the past decade. The farm is dedicated to producing meat, eggs, and vegetables for its community, ensuring a robust connection to local food sources.
